title: Eco-Tours Catalina Island Conservancy
specs: Nearly 165 miles of recreational roads and trails and 62 miles of unspoiled beaches and coves

services.name: Wildlands Discovery Tour
services.desc: A perfect introduction to Catalina’s wild side. Go beyond Avalon and discover the Catalina most visitors never see. This two-hour, naturalist-led eco tour travels through protected wildlands, rugged canyons, rolling hills and scenic overlooks, with access to areas off-limits for other tours. Along the way, your guide will share stories about Catalina’s natural and human history, habitat restoration work and the native plants and wildlife that are found nowhere else on the planet. Depending on the route, you may visit places such as Airport in the Sky, known for its famous cookies, or Middle Ranch, where you can see conservation work in action. Keep watch for Catalina Island foxes, bald

services.name: Hidden Catalina Expedition
services.desc: Get exclusive access and go farther into Catalina’s protected wildlands. This is the Conservancy’s most expansive naturalist-led eco tour. Your guide will take you on a three-hour expedition that covers the most ground of any Conservancy tour, traveling remote roads to wide-open vistas, quiet canyons and coastal edges that most visitors never reach. With more than 200 miles of roads to choose from, each route is shaped by the day’s conditions, wildlife activity and access. Your guide may travel the full Island loop, head toward far corners of the wildlands, or reach secluded viewpoints and coastal areas that reveal a wilder side of Catalina. This is the tour for guests who want it all. More

blurb: The Conservancy provides access to Catalina Island’s wildlands with nearly 165 miles of recreational roads and trails and 62 miles of unspoiled beaches and coves. They offer eco tours, hiking, camping, biking, and lead conservation and education programs. The organization focuses on stewardship of island resources balancing conservation, education, and recreation.
